Arnold-N35UH.br_basis: Published minimum at20C; nominal and maximum retained separately
Arnold-N35UH.coefficient_basis: Published reversible coefficients over20C to grade temperature limit; linear interpolation is a study approximation
Arnold-N35UH.curve_basis: Manufacturer plotted curves use nominal Br/minimum Hci and depend on size/shape; not digitised or represented as measured coupon data
Arnold-N35UH.demag_basis: Unchanged conservative80% Hcj screening factor; not a measured knee or irreversible-demagnetisation model
Arnold-N35UH.density_basis: Manufacturer typical 7.6 g/cm3; not a guaranteed batch value
Arnold-N35UH.recoil_basis: Declared linear-recoil study assumption1.05, not measured Arnold batch permeability

aluminium.source: Nominal geometry mass assumption, alloy/certificate unconfirmed

copper.basis: Declared nominal annealed copper study constants; actual winding conductor certification required.

steel.curve_basis: Hand digitized typical 50Hz polarization graph, with exact 2500/5000/10000 A/m table anchors. B=J+mu0H; +/-0.03T and +/-10%H reading uncertainty, not a measured DC/reversible law. High-field extrapolation uses vacuum slope.
steel.facing_grade_hold: Solid facing grade, B-H curve, joints, corrosion and eddy losses unqualified
steel.origin_basis: SIJ Acroni Slovenian electrical steel; UK cut/stack manufacture possible, British raw steel origin not established.

packing.field_unit: one local transverse array on ONE facing bank

vehicle_candidates.name: 6082-six-cell-compact/retained-equipment

replacement_changes.basis: Replace exact 65-member stock only; retain GFRP panels, collectors, retained hardpoints and other equipment

vehicle_candidates.scope: Body/equipment proposal before support replacement. Counted material and supplier reference values replace disjoint old accounts; no installed mass or whole-body acceptance.

thermal.reason: Retained allowance has no correlated package capacity/power map

HVAC.allowance_basis: Explicit design bands beyond package; not supplier measurements. External converter/cabling must be reconciled with retained auxiliaries; internal filters/refrigerant/fans are not counted again.
HVAC.compressor_supply: 400 V AC; 26 V DC auxiliary draw is not compressor/full-system input
HVAC.fresh_air_claim: 100 percent fresh-air capability is advertised, but delivered flow/capacity/pressure at Baghdad conditions is unqualified
unknown_items: installed duct pressure and air balance

glazing.U_basis: Declared single-glazing heat-transfer screen, not a certified complete window value
glazing.solar_basis: Rounded stationary transport windshield plot; side-window transfer unqualified

rejected_polycarbonate.reason: Rail use is documented but no exact grade/coating thickness, fire/scratch, thermal solar, stiffness, emergency retention and lifetime proof for these2m spans

frame.hold: Section stiffness and local loads do not qualify the body, bracing, attachments, crash or fatigue

material.basis: Hydro 6082 Rev.4 03/2023: hollow T6 profile <=5 mm minimum Rp0.2 250 MPa; density 2.71 g/cm3, nominal E 70 GPa. Conservative E 69 GPa retained. Batch, extrusion geometry, joints and heat effects are unqualified.

vehicle_candidates.name: 6082-six-cell-deep/retained-equipment

replacement_changes.basis: Replace exact 65-member stock only; retain GFRP panels, collectors, retained hardpoints and other equipment

vehicle_candidates.scope: Body/equipment proposal before support replacement. Counted material and supplier reference values replace disjoint old accounts; no installed mass or whole-body acceptance.

thermal.reason: Retained allowance has no correlated package capacity/power map

HVAC.allowance_basis: Explicit design bands beyond package; not supplier measurements. External converter/cabling must be reconciled with retained auxiliaries; internal filters/refrigerant/fans are not counted again.
HVAC.compressor_supply: 400 V AC; 26 V DC auxiliary draw is not compressor/full-system input
HVAC.fresh_air_claim: 100 percent fresh-air capability is advertised, but delivered flow/capacity/pressure at Baghdad conditions is unqualified
unknown_items: installed duct pressure and air balance

glazing.U_basis: Declared single-glazing heat-transfer screen, not a certified complete window value
glazing.solar_basis: Rounded stationary transport windshield plot; side-window transfer unqualified

rejected_polycarbonate.reason: Rail use is documented but no exact grade/coating thickness, fire/scratch, thermal solar, stiffness, emergency retention and lifetime proof for these2m spans

frame.hold: Section stiffness and local loads do not qualify the body, bracing, attachments, crash or fatigue

material.basis: Hydro 6082 Rev.4 03/2023: hollow T6 profile <=5 mm minimum Rp0.2 250 MPa; density 2.71 g/cm3, nominal E 70 GPa. Conservative E 69 GPa retained. Batch, extrusion geometry, joints and heat effects are unqualified.
